How much is carpet installation in Snohomish, WA?

Figure $4 to $7 per square foot installed in Snohomish — carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away included. Most projects here total $2,000 to $4,500, while a 1,200 sq ft main floor with a staircase generally runs $5,500 to $8,500. The grade you choose moves the price most, and you choose it from samples laid out in your own house.
Does OC Flooring bring the mobile carpet showroom to Snohomish?

It does. The van brings 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades to your door — whether that's a Victorian off Avenue D or a newer place out toward Clearview. Samples go down on the floor they'd cover, so the color reads true in your own light. We measure every room and stair while we're there and leave a written price the same visit, free.
What does carpet stretching cost in Snohomish?

Stretching starts at $99 per room in Snohomish. A power stretcher pulls ripples, buckles and trip spots back out for roughly a fifth of what replacement costs, which makes it the smart move any time the pile still stands up and the color still suits the room.
How much does it cost to carpet stairs in a Snohomish home?

Stairs start at $18 per step, installed waterfall or cap-and-band. Older Snohomish homes often have winders, tight landings and turns — all of it gets measured and written into the quote up front, so nothing shows up later as an extra charge.
How long does a carpet install take?

One day handles most Snohomish homes. Three or four bedrooms plus a staircase is a normal day's work for the crew; a full house with lots of stairs and heavy furniture can spill into a second day. Whatever the answer is for your house, it's stated on the written quote.
Do you move furniture during installation?

Yes — beds, dressers, sofas and tables are part of the job on most installs, and everything goes back where it started. We only ask that you empty closets and clear the small stuff: electronics, breakables, and any antiques you'd rather move with your own hands.
Should I stretch my old carpet or put in new?

If the pile stands up, the backing is sound and you still like the look, stretch it — a $99-per-room fix beats a full replacement. Replace when traffic lanes are matted flat, seams are letting go, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has outlasted professional cleaning. We identify which situation you have before quoting anything.
Which neighborhoods and areas around Snohomish do you serve?

All of Snohomish, from the Historic District and Blackmans Lake up to Fobes Hill and Kenwanda, plus the communities around town — Machias, Three Lakes, Lord Hill, Cathcart, Clearview, Maltby, Echo Lake, Silver Firs and Dubuque — and close neighbors like Mill Creek, Monroe and Lake Stevens. Farther out, the van covers most of Snohomish County — just ask when you book.
What's the best carpet for a house with pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, installed over a moisture-barrier pad. The sealed backing and barrier pad stop accidents from soaking into the subfloor — the real source of permanent odor — and solution-dyed fiber tolerates diluted-bleach cleanup without fading. That pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and both samples ride in the van.
Is the installation covered by a warranty?

OC Flooring backs the workmanship with a 1-year warranty, and the carpet carries its own mill warranty — typically 10 to 25 years on wear and stain, depending on grade. Both go on your written quote. Since the pad you pick can affect the mill's coverage, we bring all three pad grades so you can decide with the facts in front of you.
